articles.headline: Comcast Trades at 6 Times Earnings and Yields 6%. Does It Deserve to Be One of the Cheapest S&P 500 Dividend Stocks, or Is This a No-Brainer Buying Opportunity?
articles.summary: Comcast trades at a low valuation of 6x forward earnings with a 6% dividend yield, but the article advises caution. The author recommends avoiding bottom-fishing Comcast shares until subscriber losses stabilize.
